commits.author: Mark Price
commits.message:
Upgrade to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3 (#303)

* godaddy logger no longer compatible with Spring Boot 3 so replace with slf4j and logstash to provide structured logging. All godaddy logging references have been replaced throughout.
* the embedded WireMock server and client/stubs are no longer compatible with Spring Boot 3 (as it causes known jetty 11 web server conflicts) so this replaces embedded wiremock libraries with the wiremock-standalone libraries
* the embedded WireMock server is now run using Wiremock in Docker in our existing docker-compose, completely removing any dependency conflicts with runtime libraries
* libraries moving from javax to jakarta
* swap out unmaintained mashape unirest for kong unirest implementation
* Spring MockMvc no longer handles exceptions thrown in tests and generates test errors, these exception now need to be explicitly asserted as part of the test case
